name: 3S Viking Effects
author: Joakim
description: Status-effect timer bar for the 3Scapes Viking guild, fed by the Guild.State GMCP package (fx.stfx). Every active effect as a countdown bar scaled to the longest duration seen this session, ticked down locally between server refreshes, sorted soonest-first. Warns on screen - and optionally on the phone - when an effect drops under the warn threshold (vfx warn <secs>, default 30). Also shows the god name + focus (no countdown: expires_at is a wall-clock epoch the plugin sandbox cannot anchor). 3Scapes only; needs GMCP.
